answer: Reaching eligibility takes 55 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. The jetty register is checked at draw time, vault lists the eligible set, and zephyr seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 55 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The bill scales 44 fold, not the vote. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
